messages:
Maria: noticed p99 for /v1/generate jumped to ~420ms at ~10:11 UTC; p50/p95 steady. Route p99 shows ~180ms.

Josh: possible quota fallback. can you share the console query?

Maria: ran: SELECT percentile(response_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN '2024-05-05T10:05Z' AND '2024-05-05T10:20Z' GROUP BY route, sample_source

Kevin: FYI sample_source = gateway|cache_hit|backend. route rollups drop sample_source so mixed-origin t-digests can mask backend-only tails.

Maria: endpoint backend p99 ~430ms, route p99 ~180ms. how does backend tail not appear in route?

Liz: gateway and cache_hit have huge N and low latency; they dominate route rollup. backend has few samples but a heavy tail.

Kevin: counts for window: gateway=1200, cache_hit=1020, backend=80. backend N tiny.

Maria: proposal: surface origin badge + effective-N per-percentile and show low-confidence when N<100. prevents noisy paging.

Liz: UX +1. badge + tooltip with per-origin counts and effective sample size; red "! low N" indicator if N<100.

Josh: I'll open a tracking ticket and add a runbook note: check sample_origin counts and effective-N before paging. tagging eng-platform/oncall.

incident-bot: quota-fallback triggered client=acme-corp at 2024-05-05T10:11:07Z -> routing -> fallback-model-v2.
